basic_info.description: Don't miss this stylish & airy Live/Work loft in the Mission! This modern and sun-drenched loft is an urban dream with soaring windows, incredible natural light, and a sleek contemporary vibe. The bright, open floor plan features polished concrete floors and a spacious living + dining area that feels effortlessly stylish. The chef's kitchen is a standout with quartz countertops and brand-new stainless steel appliancesperfect for cooking and entertaining.  Upstairs, the lofted bedroom retreat boasts a newly renovated designer bath, extra-large closet, and fresh hard floors, all overlooking the light-filled living space.  Set in the heart of the Mission District, this home is steps from some of SF's hottest spotsgrab morning pastries at Tartine Manufactory, sip craft cocktails at True Laurel, or enjoy Michelin-star dining at Morris. With garage parking and elevator access, plus a Walk Score of 97 & Bike Score of 95, this is a true city gemdon't miss it!
